en.headline: One Stanley developer offers six-year structural cover
en.dek: K Wise says owners and buyers still completing purchases will get extra structural cover and free independent checks while a steel-bar probe continues.
body: The developer of the Stanley project One Stanley said on Friday it would give owners who have completed their purchases, and buyers still completing transactions, an extra six years of structural cover from the date of completion, on top of an existing three-year defects period.

K Wise, which South China Morning Post reported is a subsidiary of developer K&K Property, said it had contacted completed owners and was contacting buyers still in transaction. It said it would also arrange inspections by independent qualified professionals and bear the cost, with details to be announced separately.

The offer follows reports that reinforcement at the seaside development did not match approved plans. The Buildings Department has opened concrete for checks and is investigating, according to local reports.
K Wise said it understood the case had caused concern among owners, buyers and the public, and that building safety and owners' interests were its priority.

zh.headline: 赤柱ONE STANLEY發展商提供額外六年結構保養
zh.dek: 建灝旗下公司表示，已成交業主及交易中買家可獲額外六年結構保養及免費獨立檢測，屋宇署調查仍在進行。
body: 赤柱豪宅ONE STANLEY的發展商周五表示，除原有三年執修期外，將向已完成交易的業主，以及正在進行交易的買家，額外提供由成交日起計六年的物業結構保養。
據《南華早報》報道，作出回應的是建灝地產旗下公司K Wise。公司稱已聯絡已成交業主，並陸續聯絡交易中的買家，又會安排獨立合資格專業人士為業主及買家檢測，費用由公司承擔，具體安排另行通知。
事件源於早前有報道指項目鋼筋數量與獲批圖則不符。本地報道指屋宇署已鑿開混凝土檢測，調查仍在進行。
公司表示明白事件引起業主、買家及公眾關注，並稱會以樓宇安全及保障業主權益為先。
